titulo: Water on before anyone walks in
caption:
Water on before anyone walks in

The pot hopped onto the burner before anyone asked. By the time they walked in, the lid was rattling.

Putting the water on takes ten seconds, and the tea or the soup is ready the minute someone wants it.

For whoever puts the water on before anyone asks for it.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a long counter. At the right a dark burner plate and at the middle a blue soup pot with a lid. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and the pot hops in an arc onto the burner, rattles, and steam rises while the lid lifts. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me, water on before they ask.
